title: CARLAB Asset Quality Gates Specification
author: gemini-3-8-flash
description: Six-dimensional quality gates, error taxonomy, provenance requirements, and tolerance thresholds for automated CAD/GLB asset generation.

ISO_STANDARD.description: Derived directly from international mechanical standards (e.g. ISO 273 clearance, ISO 261 metric threads, ISO 724).

OEM_SPEC.description: Retrieved from verified OEM engineering data sheets, service manuals, or CMM inspection.

REVERSE_ENGINEERED.description: Derived from optical 3D scan / photogrammetry / point clouds with tolerance uncertainty bounds.

DEMO_ESTIMATE.description: Parametric approximation created for visual simulation, prototyping or unit tests.
DEMO_ESTIMATE.mandatoryDisclaimer: DEMO ONLY: Not for mechanical clearance certification

checks.description: Input JSON must adhere to PartTask schema with all mandatory fields present.
Provenance must be one of the recognized tiers; DEMO_ESTIMATE must not claim production clearance.
OEM_SPEC claims must provide structured source with sourceId, drawingNumber, and applicableScope; unverified claims are rejected.
Rejects fabricated or placeholder strings (DOES-NOT-EXIST, FAKE-*, DUMMY, PLACEHOLDER).
Source ID must resolve to an authentic record in the offline provenance registry.
Evidence doc file specified in registry must actually exist on disk; self-certified missing paths are rejected.
VERIFIED_VALID record must have a structured verificationRecord dictionary.
VERIFIED_VALID record must declare non-empty evidenceDocPath.
VERIFIED_VALID record must declare non-empty evidenceSha256.
Evidence file path must not contain directory traversal (..) or attempt path escape.
Evidence file must reside within approved evidence directories (docs/planning/evidence, cad/experiments/asset_quality_v1).
Sources designated as test fixtures (tier: TEST_ONLY) are prohibited from satisfying OEM_SPEC in production mode.
Evidence doc file SHA-256 on disk must match the hash recorded in provenance registry.
Registry entry must have VERIFIED_VALID status; unverified fixtures fail closed under OEM_SPEC.
Claimed drawing number must match the registered drawing number in provenance registry.
Part ID must be authorized in registeredParts for the cited evidence source.
ISO_STANDARD provides geometric/tolerance rules; claiming vehicle assembly release without OEM engineering release document is rejected.
DEMO_ESTIMATE parts must explicitly flag is_demo_only: true and include mandatory disclaimer.
Physical parameters must be positive and within reasonable engineering envelopes.
Relational constraints must be satisfied (e.g. PCD > hub bore, hole > stud diameter).
The evaluated B-Rep solid must report valid geometry (is_valid == true).
Solid must be a closed, watertight manifold shell with no open boundary edges (is_closed == true).
Solid volume must be strictly positive (> 1.0e-3 mm³).
Bounding box coordinates must be finite numbers and satisfy min < max on all axes.
Fastener clearance holes must adhere strictly to ISO 273 (Fine, Medium, or Coarse).
checks.standardsReference: ISO 273:1979 Fasteners -- Clearance holes for bolts and screws

checks.description: Mating non-fastener solids must have zero physical penetration volume.
Mounting frame positions and axes between connected components must coincide within tolerance.
Scale along all axes must be exactly 0.001 (mm to m conversion).
Rotation matrix must be strictly orthogonal (R^T * R = I).
Determinant of normalized 3x3 transform must be +1.0 (no mirrored left-handed reflection).
Total triangle count must not exceed budget threshold.
Exported binary GLB file size must not exceed the ceiling limit.
All GLB visual nodes must contain extras matching provenance and identification records.
Identical parts (e.g. wheel studs) must share underlying glTF mesh data blocks.
Cache key must be derived from canonical parameter serialization + pipeline engine version.
Cached binary assets must match SHA-256 checksum recorded in metadata manifest.
Any failure across Gates 1-5 must cleanly delete staging outputs without contaminating production cache.
